rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: Who is a non-resident taxpayer (buitenlands belastingplichtige)
rows.value: Someone who does not live in the Netherlands but has Dutch income
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Fiscale informatie 2026, chapter 30 U woont buiten Nederland; Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: Residence test
rows.value: Judged on the facts and circumstances: a lasting personal tie with the Netherlands, where the person's social and economic life is centred (for someone without a family, also the intention to settle); the law sets no day count
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, article 4 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026); Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, paragraph 2.3.3 (printed page 41)

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: What a non-resident pays income tax on
rows.value: Box 1 income tax at the normal rates on pay for work done in the Netherlands, and on other Dutch income such as profit from a Dutch permanent establishment
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Fiscale informatie 2026, chapter 30 U woont buiten Nederland; Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: How it is collected
rows.value: The employer withholds wage tax on that pay; the premium part of the payroll tax credit applies only while the employee is insured for national insurance in the Netherlands
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 24 (printed page 431)

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: Tax credits (tax part) in the payroll
rows.value: Not for non-residents, except the labour tax credit for residents of the EU, the EEA, Switzerland and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba; residents of Belgium, Suriname and Aruba also get the general tax credit
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 24 (printed page 431)

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: Qualifying non-resident: share of worldwide income taxed in the Netherlands at least
rows.note: for residents of the EU, the EEA, Switzerland or the BES islands; gives deductions and the tax part of the tax credits

rows.section: Non-residents: employment income
rows.label: Other non-residents
rows.value: No deductions and no fiscal partner; only the tax part of the labour tax credit and the income-related combination tax credit can apply
rows.note: Tax treaties decide which country may tax pay for work done in the Netherlands; the period in which the 183 days are counted differs per treaty. Someone who lives abroad but is insured in the Netherlands also pays national insurance premiums on box 1 income.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Fiscale informatie 2026, chapter 30 U woont buiten Nederland; Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.value: Announced, not yet law: bill 36912, submitted to the House of Representatives on 24 March 2026, not yet debated or voted on; no premium or start date is law
rows.basis: Premium income (box 1 income) and contribution income, per year
rows.note: There is no minimum contribution. The entrepreneur deductions (self-employed deduction, SME profit exemption) are in the freelancers section.
rows.source_title: Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal: Wetsvoorstel 36912, Wet basisverzekering arbeidsongeschiktheid zelfstandigen (status page)

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Official test: employee or self-employed
rows.value: Employment has three marks: the possibility of employer authority (gezag), the obligation to do the work personally, and pay for the work; all facts and circumstances are weighed (nature and length of the work, how work and hours are set, integration in the client's organisation, commercial risk, behaving as an entrepreneur)
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Wanneer is er sprake van loondienst? (arbeidsrelaties)

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Official guidance
rows.value: Belastingdienst: Toelichting Beoordeling arbeidsrelaties and annex 3 of the Handboek Loonheffingen; the Webmodule Beoordeling Arbeidsrelatie of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Wanneer is er sprake van loondienst? (arbeidsrelaties)

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Withholding on payments to contractors
rows.value: None for work outside (fictitious) employment: the contractor pays income tax and the Zvw contribution through his own assessment
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 1 (printed page 33)

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Fictitious employment (fictieve dienstbetrekking)
rows.value: Some contractors count as employees by law, so the client withholds wage taxes: for example people who usually work 2 or more days a week and earn at least 2/5 of the minimum wage (gelijkgestelden), homeworkers, artists and professional athletes, and workers placed through an intermediary; for gelijkgestelden, homeworkers and artists both parties can opt out in writing before the first payment
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Wanneer is er sprake van loondienst? (arbeidsrelaties)

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Wet DBA enforcement
rows.value: Normal rules since 1 January 2025 (end of the enforcement moratorium): correction orders and back assessments directly; penalties for gross negligence or intent from 1 January 2026; no default penalties in 2026; back assessments not before 1 January 2025 unless in bad faith (then up to 5 years)
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Werken in loondienst, gevolgen voor de opdrachtgever; Arbeidsrelaties en handhaving door de Belastingdienst

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Wage tax and national insurance rate on reassessed pay where the client could have known it was employment
rows.note: without the maximum premium and contribution wage; in good faith the normal rates apply
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Werken in loondienst, gevolgen voor de opdrachtgever; Arbeidsrelaties en handhaving door de Belastingdienst

rows.section: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements
rows.label: Model agreements (modelovereenkomsten)
rows.value: No new ones assessed since 6 September 2024; approved agreements valid on that date may be used until 31 December 2029, and give certainty only if the work is done as written
rows.note: A client who wrongly treats an employee as self-employed must correct the payroll tax returns and pay the wage taxes, with interest on a back assessment.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Geen nieuwe modelovereenkomsten meer; Werken met modelovereenkomsten

rows.section: Small businesses: the VAT small business scheme (KOR)
rows.label: KOR: turnover limit per calendar year
rows.note: The KOR is a VAT scheme only. The Belastingdienst pages checked describe no flat-rate or presumptive income tax for small businesses.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Kleineondernemersregeling (KOR); Wat betekent meedoen met de KOR?

rows.section: Small businesses: the VAT small business scheme (KOR)
rows.label: KOR: what it does
rows.value: VAT exemption: no VAT charged to customers, no VAT returns, no VAT reclaimed on costs and investments; open to sole traders, partnerships and legal entities established in the Netherlands
rows.note: The KOR is a VAT scheme only. The Belastingdienst pages checked describe no flat-rate or presumptive income tax for small businesses.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Kleineondernemersregeling (KOR); Wat betekent meedoen met de KOR?

rows.section: Small businesses: the VAT small business scheme (KOR)
rows.label: Leaving the KOR
rows.value: At once when turnover passes €20,000 in a calendar year
rows.note: The KOR is a VAT scheme only. The Belastingdienst pages checked describe no flat-rate or presumptive income tax for small businesses.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Kleineondernemersregeling (KOR); Wat betekent meedoen met de KOR?

rows.section: Small businesses: the VAT small business scheme (KOR)
rows.label: EU small business scheme (EU-KOR): total EU turnover limit per calendar year
rows.note: since 1 January 2025; each other EU country's own limit also applies
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Kleineondernemersregeling in de EU (EU-KOR)

rows.section: Small businesses: the VAT small business scheme (KOR)
rows.label: Income tax
rows.value: No presumptive or turnover-based income tax: sole traders pay box 1 income tax on their profit (entrepreneur deductions in the freelancers section); companies pay corporate tax
rows.note: The KOR is a VAT scheme only. The Belastingdienst pages checked describe no flat-rate or presumptive income tax for small businesses.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Veranderingen vennootschapsbelasting 2026; Tarieven voor de vennootschapsbelasting; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Corporate tax (vennootschapsbelasting), 2026
rows.basis: Taxable amount, per financial year
rows.note: The same rates applied in 2023 to 2025. Tax on the first €200,000 is €38,000. Companies (BV, NV and other bodies) established in the Netherlands pay it on their profit; sole traders pay income tax instead.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Veranderingen vennootschapsbelasting 2026; Tarieven voor de vennootschapsbelasting; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Corporate tax (vennootschapsbelasting), 2026
rows.basis: Taxable amount, per financial year
rows.note: The same rates applied in 2023 to 2025. Tax on the first €200,000 is €38,000. Companies (BV, NV and other bodies) established in the Netherlands pay it on their profit; sole traders pay income tax instead.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Veranderingen vennootschapsbelasting 2026; Tarieven voor de vennootschapsbelasting; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Minimum tax (Wet minimumbelasting 2024): minimum effective rate

rows.label: Minimum tax: group revenue of at least (consolidated, per year)

rows.section: Corporate tax: innovation box and minimum tax (Pillar Two)
rows.label: Top-up tax return due within (months after the reporting year)
rows.note: 20 months for the first year
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Minimumbelasting (Wet minimumbelasting 2024)

rows.section: Branch profits and distributed profits
rows.label: Branches of foreign companies
rows.value: Pay corporate tax on the profit of the Dutch permanent establishment at the same rates (19% up to €200,000, 25.8% above); no separate branch profits tax
rows.note: Dividend tax is withheld from the shareholder's dividend and credited in the shareholder's income tax or corporate tax return.
rows.source_title: Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, articles 3 and 17 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026); Belastingdienst: Belastingplicht en aangifte vennootschapsbelasting (vpb)

rows.section: Branch profits and distributed profits
rows.label: Dividend tax (dividendbelasting) on dividends from Dutch companies
rows.note: withheld by the company; exemptions apply, for example participation dividends to Dutch companies are usually exempt
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Dividendbelasting als u dividend uitkeert; Dividendbelasting (overview); Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965, article 5 (wetten.overheid.nl)

rows.section: Branch profits and distributed profits
rows.label: Conditional withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties to affiliates in low-tax jurisdictions (Wet bronbelasting 2021)
rows.note: equal to the top corporate tax rate; dividend tax already withheld is credited
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Bronbelasting op renten, royalty's en dividenden (Wet bronbelasting 2021)

rows.section: Branch profits and distributed profits
rows.label: Low-tax jurisdiction: profit tax rate below
rows.note: or no profit tax, or on the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Bronbelasting op renten, royalty's en dividenden (Wet bronbelasting 2021)

rows.section: Branch profits and distributed profits
rows.label: Affiliation
rows.value: A qualifying interest: influence that can determine the other entity's activities, in any case more than 50% of the voting rights
rows.note: Dividend tax is withheld from the shareholder's dividend and credited in the shareholder's income tax or corporate tax return.
rows.source_title: Belastingdienst: Bronbelasting op renten, royalty's en dividenden (Wet bronbelasting 2021)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: What it is
rows.value: A municipal tax on real estate: owners of homes and of non-residential property pay an owners' tax; users of non-residential property pay a users' tax
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Base
rows.value: The WOZ value set for the year under the Valuation of Immovable Property Act (Wet waardering onroerende zaken)
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Rates
rows.value: A percentage of the WOZ value, set each year by each municipality in its tax ordinance, separately for owners of homes, owners of non-residential property and users of non-residential property; the law sets no national rate or cap
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Whoever owns or uses the property on 1 January pays for the whole year; for a home only the owner pays
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Ondernemersplein (RVO): Onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB) voor bedrijfspand betalen (checked 30 September 2026), with links to each municipality's OZB rates

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Municipalities may exempt properties with a WOZ value below
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Left out of the base (examples)
rows.value: Agricultural land in business use, nature areas, public roads and railways, water defences and sewage works run by public bodies
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Each municipality's rates
rows.value: Listed per municipality on Ondernemersplein (https://ondernemersplein.overheid.nl/wetten-en-regels/onroerendezaakbelasting-ozb/) and in each municipality's tax ordinance; no national range is stored
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Ondernemersplein (RVO): Onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB) voor bedrijfspand betalen (checked 30 September 2026), with links to each municipality's OZB rates

rows.section: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)
rows.label: Water authority levy (waterschapsbelasting)
rows.value: A separate levy by the regional water authorities (watersysteemheffing) on residents and on owners of built and unbuilt property; each water authority sets its own rates
rows.note: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h. The WOZ value also sets other charges, such as the water authority levy on buildings.
rows.source_title: Waterschapswet, article 117 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.section: Property transfer tax (overdrachtsbelasting)
rows.label: Home the buyer will live in as main residence

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Corporate tax (vennootschapsbelasting) [national]
rows.value: 19% on the taxable amount up to €200,000, 25.8% above; 9% effective rate in the innovation box; 15% minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by companies (BV, NV and other bodies) established in the Netherlands, and foreign companies with Dutch income such as a permanent establishment. Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22; Wet minimumbelasting 2024.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: branch profits: corporate tax at the same rates, no separate branch tax; dividends: 15% dividend tax; 25.8% conditional withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties to affiliates in low-tax jurisdictions. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); the paying company for the conditional withholding tax. Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965; Wet bronbelasting 2021; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, articles 3 and 17.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Self-employed contributions: national insurance and Zvw [national]
rows.value: AOW 17.9%, Anw 0.1% and Wlz 9.65% on box 1 income up to €38,883, charged with income tax; Zvw contribution 4.85% on profit up to €79,409; no employee insurances. Paid by self-employed people (by assessment). Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen; Zorgverzekeringswet.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Contractor or employee: employment test and Wet DBA [national]
rows.value: no withholding on payments to self-employed contractors; wage taxes are due where the work is employment (authority, personal work, pay) or fictitious employment; normal enforcement since 1 January 2025. Paid by clients who engage workers (opdrachtgevers). Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 (employment and fictitious employment); Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA).
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Simplified regimes: small business scheme (kleineondernemersregeling, KOR) [national]
rows.value: VAT exemption for turnover up to €20,000 a calendar year; EU-KOR up to €100,000 of EU turnover; no presumptive income tax. Paid by no one: it is an exemption that small businesses can opt into. Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: box 1 income tax at the normal rates on pay for work in the Netherlands, withheld by the employer; tax part of the tax credits only for qualifying non-residents (90% test) and, for the labour tax credit, residents of the EU, EEA, Switzerland and the BES islands. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2; Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, article 4 (residence).
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, national insurance and employer premiums are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB) [municipal]
